    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age

  AND
  -- Check month/day: birth month/day <= 2026-09-25 month/day
  SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '09-25'

  -- If birth month/day == 09-25, it's exactly 25 today (already satisfied)

  -- Simpler: compute the 25th anniversary date and compare
  AND
  (
    -- 25th anniversary date = birth_year + 25, same month/day
    SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '2026-09-25'
